hint.text: A Concoction is something that is prepared using many different ingredients. Often, a concoction is something to drink, like a potion.

instruction.text: Complete the poem “A Fabulous Concoction” by choosing the options that rhyme and match the rhythm.

atoms.b:
Today is the day to jump in the fray,
Your guests will eat a delicious ((++buffet meal)).
You are hosting a big dinner party!
Everyone attending will be dressed ((++so_smartly in_their_pyjamas)).
atoms.sound: Today is the day to jump in the fray, your guests will eat a delicious buff-ay. You are hosting a big dinner party, everyone attending will be dressed so smartly.

atoms.b:
For tonight the special dish will be soup,
This recipe makes enough for a ((++troop horse))!
First go the carrots, onion and broth,
Then let the soup bubble, ((++sputter_and_froth simmer_and_boil)).

Now pay attention! Once it gets hot,
don’t forget to keep stirring the ((++pot soup))!
Finally, it’s time to turn down the heat,
As you have all your lovely guests to ((++greet say_hello_to))!

b: making pizza for a dinner party
++hosting a dinner party and making soup
having a pet snake as a best friend
